name: Swarna Sootashekhar Rasa

sections.introduction: Swarna Sootashekhar Rasa is an ayurvedic formulation which is prepared from the mixture of herbs and minerals. This medicine is very helpful in problems regarding stomach and digestion.
sections.ingredients:
Juice extract of Bhringaraja – Eclipta alba (in sufficient quantity) 
 Shuddha Parada purified Mercury 
 Suddha gandhaka – purified sulphur 
 Swarna Bhasma – Gold calx 
 Roupya Bhasma – silver calx 
 Suddha suhaga – purified borax 
 Saunth – Zingiber officinalis 
 Maricha – Piper nigrum 
 Pippali – Piper longum 
 Dattura – Datura herb seeds 
 Tamra Bhasma – Copper calx 
 Ilaichi – Elettaria cardamomum 
 Daalchinni – Cinnamomum zeylanicum 
 Tejpatta – Cinnamomum tamala 
 Nagakeshara – Mesua ferrea 
 Shankha Bhasma – Conch Shell calx 
 Fruit pulp of Bilva – Aegle marmelos 
 Kachura – Curcuma zedoaria 

 Method of Preparation 

 First of all take the parada and gandhaka. 
 Make the kajjali of this mixture. 
 Make the powder of all other ingredients and mix with kajjali. 
 Now ground the above mixture with juice extract of bhang for 21 days. 
 After 21 days, take the paste up to 250 mg and make the pills from it. 

 Medicinal Properties 
 Swarna Sootashekhar Rasa, an Ayurvedic medicine which is prepared by the combination of natural ingredients. It is effective medicine to manage the gastrointestinal problems like dyspepsia, acidity, gastritis, vomiting, abdominal pain, diarrhea, dysentery, bloating, indigestion etc. It is good medicine for cough and cold. Natural ingredients used in this medicine are packed with the cooling properties. This medicine supports the good health of digestive system and stimulates the healthy digestion. Anti-microbial action of this medicine is quite effective in diarrhea and dysentery as it helps to extrude the harmful microorganisms from stomach. Swarna Sootashekhar Rasa is known to be quite good in the problems of hiccups as it helps to manage the involuntary contractions of the diaphragm. On the other hand, it is good medicine for the problem of cough and cold. In the cough and cold, this medicine helps to clear the mucous, phlegm or cough in the respiratory problems.
sections.indications:
Acidity

 Dyspepsia
sections.dose: One – one pill, two times a day, with honey, clarified butter or with pomegranate’s juice.
sections.contraindications:
Avoid in lactation and pregnancy. 
 Take the medicine under doctor’s prescription. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
